title: A Weekend at the Guest House
transcript:
Hello, is that the guest house? I'm looking for somewhere for my partner, our son and me next weekend.
Yes, there's a family room free from Friday. It has a double bed and a single, and it's on the first floor.
That sounds good. I saw a picture of a room looking over the street. Is that the one?
That's our smaller room. Yours looks onto the back garden, which is usually quieter in the morning.
Lovely. We have an early start on Saturday. When do you begin serving breakfast?
At seven thirty. If you tell us on Friday, we can have your order ready when you come down.
Thanks. My son can't have ordinary milk. Could you put some oat milk aside?
Yes, we keep it in the kitchen. I'll make a note for breakfast.
Great. Do you need a deposit today?
Just a contact number for now. You can pay when you arrive.

questions.explanation: 店家说从周五起有一间配有双人床和单人床的家庭房。
店家说明预订的房间朝向后花园。
店家说早饭从七点半开始供应。

questions.prompt: What will the guest house set aside for the child?
questions.explanation: 客人请店家留些燕麦奶，店家答应为早餐记下这个要求。

questions.prompt: When should the guest pay for the room?
questions.explanation: 店家说现在只需提供联系电话，抵达时再付款。
